description: PriceMonitor reads slot0()/globalState()/getReserves() which return stale prices even when a pool has zero in-range liquidity. This caused a phantom 42.7% spread on PREMIA/WETH (UniV3 pool had 0 liquidity but stale sqrtPriceX96). Fix: before accepting a price snapshot, check liquidity. For V3/Algebra pools call liquidity() and reject if 0. For V2 pools check that both reserves exceed a minimum threshold (e.g. 0.01 ETH equivalent). Pools failing the check should emit a 'stale' event and be excluded from opportunity detection. Discovered in dry-run session 2026-02-19.
title: Add minimum liquidity filter to PriceMonitor to reject empty pools
